cases.purpose: Lock idempotently, remove exactly one lock marker, preserve aging and reject missing users without changing bytes.
cases.oracle: shadow password field lock marker and aging field preservation
cases.script:
export PHCLIB_PASSWD=db/passwd PHCLIB_GROUP=db/group PHCLIB_SHADOW=db/shadow BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0
passwd lock alice; printf 'lock=%d ' "$?"; /usr/bin/cat db/shadow
passwd unlock alice; printf 'unlock=%d ' "$?"; /usr/bin/cat db/shadow
/usr/bin/cp db/shadow snap
passwd lock missing 2>/dev/null; r=$?; /usr/bin/cmp -s db/shadow snap; printf 'missing-lock=%d unchanged=%d\n' "$r" "$?"
passwd expire missing 2>/dev/null; r=$?; /usr/bin/cmp -s db/shadow snap; printf 'missing-expire=%d unchanged=%d\n' "$r" "$?"
cases.stdout:
lock=0 alice:!!hash:123:1:90:7:4:999:
unlock=0 alice:!hash:123:1:90:7:4:999:
missing-lock=1 unchanged=0
missing-expire=1 unchanged=0
